answer: First the chain issues a live re-derivation challenge: reproduce the reasoning under a new seed in 90 seconds, with the forge words changed so a memorised script is useless. The verifier scores the fresh derivation against the original and rejects any drift in structure or dropped step. One honest agent re-derives once in 90 seconds; 10 fakes must re-derive 10 fresh answers in parallel, about $800 in GPU time. Peers check the public log and slash the bond of a ripple failure, freezing repeat offenders, so a vine copy farm cannot keep up when every clone must think again.
